ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   B. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)

   C. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   B. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   C. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

9. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   D. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   B. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   C. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

15. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
